name: @penguinharness/data-analysis

penguin.short_description: Deliver correct data-analysis artifacts with bounded verification.
penguin.short_description_zh: 以正确数据语义完成产物并进行有界核查。

quick_start.prompt: Create a CSV of 30 days of made-up daily sales in this Workspace, then analyze it: weekly totals, the best and the worst day, and a line chart saved as sales.png.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 在当前工作区生成一份 30 天的虚构日销售额 CSV，然后分析它：每周合计、最好和最差的一天，并把折线图保存为 sales.png。
